scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @gridflow/domain && npm run build --workspace @gridflow/agents && npm run build --workspace @gridflow/database && npm run build --workspace @gridflow/integrations && npm run build --workspace @gridflow/engine
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run db:migrate && concurrently -k -n api,web,worker -c auto "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @gridflow/api && npm run build --workspace @gridflow/worker && npm run build --workspace @gridflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @gridflow/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @gridflow/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @gridflow/web
scripts.test: vitest run apps/api/test packages/agents/test packages/domain/test packages/database/test packages/integrations/test packages/engine/test --maxWorkers=1
scripts.smoke: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @gridflow/api && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs
scripts.smoke:auth: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @gridflow/api && node scripts/auth-smoke-test.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:auth
